sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Lophopyxis maingayi is a woody climber of humid tropical forests, ranging from peninsular Thailand to the Caroline Islands. It is the only species in its genus; the sources consulted do not provide a reliable height.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The simple, alternate leaves bear domatia. Small flowers grow in leaf axils. The distinctive dry fruit has five wings and contains one seed.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use was documented in the sources consulted.
